description: Under the glass roof of an outdoor flower market at dusk, on wet pavement, a young woman with sunglasses on her head, in a camel jacket and dark jeans, holds out a banknote to a stallholder and takes a large bunch of pink and red dahlias. She hugs the flowers to her chest and walks away towards the camera, smiling. Metal buckets of flowers stand on the ground and hang above, hanging scales dangle from the stall roof, rolls of wrapping paper are fixed to the counter and a woman waits behind her.
